mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO attendance_exception(id, exception_id, department, `position`, `name`, attendance_month, is_verify) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.exceptionId}, #{item.department}, #{item.position}, #{item.name}, #{item.attendanceMonth}, #{item.isVerify})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_verify = '0'

INSERT INTO attendance_exception_data(id,attendance_date,actual_start_work_time,actual_end_work_time,type,exception_id) VALUES
(#{item.id},#{item.attendanceDate},#{item.actualStartWorkTime},#{item.actualEndWorkTime},#{item.type},#{item.exceptionId})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE actual_start_work_time = VALUES(actual_start_work_time), actual_end_work_time = VALUES(actual_end_work_time), type = VALUES(type)
mapper.delete: delete from attendance_exception_data where attendance_date >= #{startDate} and attendance_date <= #{endDate}
